proposed_comments.title: Compare equivalent patches across the full opposite history

confidence.rationale: The changed function calls git cherry, whose comparison is limited by the merge base, while the documented branch-transition behavior requires equivalent patches anywhere in the opposite reachable history. The fork-side fix replaces this with full-history patch-ID matching and the existing regression suite remains green.
